SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE ring only, standing upright on the top face, seen from the front and a little above: the marquise and the molten bar stand upright side by side, and from each of them the band runs straight on DOWN in the same line and curves away behind into the loop of the ring, so the loop is seen edge-on as a narrow upright oval; nothing runs left to right behind them, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is a phone photograph of the actual piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is the owner's photo of the ring worn on a finger, with a tray of other rings blurred behind: take ONLY the ring on the finger. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the same ring. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING made of ONE slim polished gold band about 1.5mm wide that does NOT close. The band's two open ends sit side by side on top of the finger, and BOTH run in the SAME direction as the band itself, around the finger. At one end ONE large clear MARQUISE-cut faceted stone is set LENGTHWISE along the band in four gold claws, its long axis following the band, with the slim band running down its side like a rail. The band's other end becomes ONE long molten gold BAR: a smooth organic rod about 2.5mm thick, slightly wavy, with rounded droplet ends, continuing the line of the band and about two and a half times as long as the marquise. So the marquise and the bar lie side by side and parallel, both in line with the band; on the finger both lie ACROSS the finger. Exactly one stone, a clear marquise, never round, oval or pear; no pave, no halo; the bar is smooth polished gold with soft ripples, never a straight machined bar, never set with stones; the band does not close. The band NEVER crosses behind the marquise and the bar at right angles: never a cross or plus shape, never a straight rod running left to right behind them.

SCALE TEST: The marquise is about 5x10mm; the molten bar is about 25mm long and 2.5mm thick, about two and a half times the marquise's length. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
